endpoints.name: Colerain
endpoints.coordinateSource: Overpass: the Georgia Power 230 kV line way/174697775 (33.88 mi from Thalmann) ends at this node. It is a 3-way junction with 230 kV lines way/174710400 (2.15 mi to Kingsland Primary) and way/160712391 (7.86 mi to Kings Bay Base Substation #1). Colerain Road (way/969656228) ends 0.87 km west. Nominatim reverse = Kingsland, Camden County
endpoints.validation: No OSM substation is named Colerain. The only Georgia Power 230 kV line running south from Thalmann ends at this unmapped junction in Kingsland, 0.87 km from Colerain Road. The two branches beyond it end at differently named stations (Kingsland Primary, Kings Bay Base), so the Colerain station is most likely at or near this junction, though that is unconfirmed. The earlier point (the Nominatim Colerain Road centroid, 30.8213,-81.7169) was 3.6 km west of the line. Colerain hamlet (30.833,-81.901) is 21 km off the line and was rejected.

projects.notes: Relay work happens at both ends of the Thalmann - Colerain 230 kV line. Page 214.

unresolved: gpc:10222 Huckleberry: not found. Gazetteer, Nominatim and web search found nothing in Early or Calhoun County. The topological candidates are ambiguous, so the project center rests on Blakely Primary alone.

gpc:20223 Dothan Road (new station): locality only. The Farley - South Bainbridge line runs 1.5-5 km south of US 84 west of Bainbridge, and the exact split point is unknown. Downrange is now placed at Downrange Industrial Park by a name inference: locality, lower-confidence.

gpc:21093 North Spa: new station, and Oasis is unnamed in OSM. Topology places Oasis at the unnamed Georgia Power 230/115 kV station at 33.6112,-83.6395 (Centennial, Morgan County), so North Spa is a locality with 8 km uncertainty.

gpc:20298 / gpc:19626 Glenwood Springs: no substation identified. It is placed as a locality on Glenwood Springs Road, Eatonton, because the only substation there is 'Eatonton Primary' in the same plan.
gpc:21046 Colerain: no substation identified. It is placed as a locality at the unmapped 230 kV junction in Kingsland where the Thalmann line ends.
gpc:18800 / gpc:19627 Wellston: no substation identified. The Warner Robins locality is used, since Wellston is the old name of the city.
gpc:18690 Palmyra: no substation identified. The Palmyra hamlet locality (Lee County) is used. A MEAG 115 kV station on Palmyra Road, Albany is an unconfirmed candidate.
gpc:20684 Camden Industrial Park (GTC, new): the Industrial Park, Kinlaw, Kingsland locality is used.
gpc:20284 Pearson tap and gpc:19618 Engelhard McIntyre J: the tap and junction points are not mapped, so nearby named substations serve as locality-level proxies.

Lower-confidence facility matches (unnamed or differently named OSM features): Pittman Road (OSM 'West Point Substation'), First Avenue, North Columbus (OSM 'Highlands Dam Substation'), South Warner Robins (OSM 'South'), Echeconnee, Griffin Rd, Climax.

Section junctions not located and described only in notes: PPG J2 and Langston Road (gpc:19997); North Eatonton Jct and Putnam Sawmill Jct (gpc:20298, candidate nodes 33.330,-83.378 and 33.298,-83.354); Four Mile tap and Recovery (gpc:13628); Wesley (gpc:16887); North Dublin (gpc:19618).
issuesFixed: gpc:20298 and gpc:19626 Glenwood Springs was a false named-facility match. The researcher pinned it to OSM way/171527955 'Eatonton Substation', which the same plan calls 'Eatonton Primary' (gpc:20466), so two different plan stations shared one coordinate. Downgraded to precision locality on Glenwood Springs Road, Eatonton (Nominatim 33.3018,-83.4040), with uncertainty 1500 -> 5000 m, still lower-confidence. Overpass topology was added: Lake Oconee -> Phoenix -> junction north of Eatonton -> node east of town -> Eatonton Substation.

gpc:20223 Downrange: filled in an endpoint the researcher marked not-found. The name matches Downrange Industrial Park, Bainbridge, at 30.9324,-84.5734 per the Locate South Georgia listing. Two new public sources were cached with excerpts verified: locatesouthga-downrange-listing and dabdc-industrial-parks-page. Set to locality, 2000 m, lower-confidence. It is 9.2 mi straight from Climax, consistent with the plan's 10-mile line.

gpc:20223 Dothan Road: coordinate kept, but the validation was corrected. The Farley - South Bainbridge line crosses Dothan Road (US 84) only at 30.98,-84.75, which is 20.2 mi from Climax and so incompatible with the plan's line lengths. The split point is therefore on the stretch west of Bainbridge where the line runs 1.5-5 km south of US 84. Climax uncertainty 1500 -> 1000 m, to fit the named-facility range.

gpc:21046 Colerain: the locality moved from the Nominatim Colerain Road centroid (30.8213,-81.7169), which was 3.6 km off the line, to the unmapped 230 kV junction (30.82615,-81.67993). That is where the OSM Georgia Power line way/174697775 from Thalmann actually ends, 0.87 km from Colerain Road. Still locality, 5000 m, lower-confidence.

gpc:19618 Engelhard McIntyre J: precision named-facility -> locality, uncertainty 2000 -> 3000 m. The coordinate is a proxy (Engelhard Substation), not the junction itself. Gordon kept as confirmed, with a note that its OSM voltage tag lists only 230 kV.

gpc:13166 First Avenue: coordinate moved 0.19 km from way/979692779 to way/186406808 (32.48187,-84.9923). Overpass shows the Georgia Power 115 kV line way/958269650 terminates there. The line length was corrected from 0.90 to 0.95 mi as measured on its geometry.

gpc:20482 Pittman Road: the validation was corrected with the measured length of the Georgia Power line way/1058469135: 3.03 mi, not a 2.8 mi straight distance. Also added: an Overpass search found no Pittman road within 60 km, and the only other line at West Point Dam is a PowerSouth line. Still lower-confidence.
gpc:18800 South Warner Robins: uncertainty 1500 -> 1000 m, to fit the named-facility range.
gpc:18848 East Bainbridge: uncertainty 2000 -> 1000 m, to fit the named-facility range. The new East River Road station, about 1 mi north, is kept in notes.

gpc:18690 Palmyra: the validation distances were corrected. From the hamlet, Albany Utilities is 3.3 km and MEAG is 5.4 km, not '2.5-4 km'. Added the MEAG 115 kV station on Palmyra Road (way/1039823933, 0.1 km from the road) as an unconfirmed candidate. The coordinate is unchanged.
gpc:19248 Wadley Primary: added South Wadley Substation (24.9 mi straight, longer than the 24.3-mi line) and Wadley, Alabama (wrong state) as rejected same-name candidates. Still confirmed.

gpc:20512 Kathleen: re-verified that line way/160308111 (6.10 mi) runs from Bonaire Primary and ends 46 m from the station. Recorded that the Mid-Georgia Cogeneration Substation 1.8 km west is a different facility. Still confirmed.

All other named-facility and locality endpoints were re-checked against the bulk OSM export, where every cited way ID exists with the stated name, operator and voltage. They were also re-checked with gazetteer name searches, run to catch same-name stations in other counties, and with Nominatim. Every title and terminal name was re-read from the cached pages and matches. The out-of-state terminals Webb (APC), Farley (APC) and Sinai (FPL) are explicitly named in the plan titles and are correct.
